facts.text: I am thinking of rearranging my living room.
I recently got a new coffee table from IKEA on sale for $50.
I want the new coffee table to be the centerpiece of my living room.
I am considering putting a mirror above the couch to reflect light and make the room feel brighter.
I am considering repainting the walls a lighter shade to brighten up the space.
I am considering a soft gray or beige wall color to work with my new coffee table and rug.
I will go with a soft gray wall color.
I want to create a calm and serene atmosphere in my living room.
The lamp on my side table has been acting up lately.
I am not sure whether to fix the lamp or get a new one.
I do not want the flickering to be a distraction in the room.
I want suggestions for a lamp that would complement my coffee table and rug.
I am going to check out lamp options online.
I am deciding whether to consider table lamps or floor lamps.

events.text: Bought a new IKEA coffee table on sale for $50.
Decided to go with a soft gray wall color.
Decided to replace the side table lamp due to flickering.
Planned to check out lamp options online and compare table lamps vs floor lamps.
